messages.plaintextBody: James - two points on the DPA (Schedule 3) before we sign off: (1) can Caspian confirm production hosting stays in the UK for the full term? (2) we'd like 48-hour breach notification rather than 'without undue delay' alone. Rupa Carver, Head of Legal, Brookmere

messages.subject: RE: Brookmere MSA - DPA queries
messages.plaintextBody:
Rupa,

(1) Confirmed - production Customer Data is hosted in the UK (AWS eu-west-2) and Schedule 3 says so. (2) Agreed - the DPA already provides for notification 'without undue delay and in any event within 48 hours', which should meet your point. No change needed but happy to highlight it on the call.

James

--
James Osei
Senior Associate, Commercial
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
